text: Next time you start doing something that you were putting off, notice what changed. This single stint is a key to hack your patterns. We procrastinate, lose focus, get lazy when there is a resistance of doing stints and this resistance comes from the pain that we associate to it. The moment we finally break through it, the moment when the pain of not doing it becomes stronger than the pain of doing it. The big secret is not to wait for it to happen on its own months or years later, but to use this pattern to your advantage. How? By associating a huge amount of pleasure with doing this thing. Think about all of the rewards that will happen because you did it, what it unlocks for you, and also by associating pain with not having all of that pleasure if you don't do it. If you're still watching, it's very likely that you're in the 1% that is not ready to set up for less. Follow me
